title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF TWO HUNDRED AND THIRTY-FOUR THOUSAND PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, FOR THE CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR OF ROADS IN THE PROVINCE
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF TWO HUNDRED AND THIRTY-FOUR THOUSAND PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, FOR THE CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR OF ROADS IN THE PROVINCE
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp ngân sách hai trăm ba mươi bốn nghìn peso tiền Philippines cho việc xây dựng và sửa chữa đường sá tại Tỉnh Abra

title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan dana dua ratus tiga puluh empat ribu peso mata uang Filipina untuk pembangunan dan perbaikan jalan di Provinsi Abra
title.ms: Akta memperuntukkan jumlah dua ratus tiga puluh empat ribu peso mata wang Filipina bagi pembinaan dan pembaikan jalan di Wilayah Abra

text.en:
The sum of two hundred and thirty-four thousand pesos, Philippine currency, or so much thereof
as may be necessary, is hereby appropriated, out of any money in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the same to be charged to the Congressional relief fund, for the purpose of constructing and
repairing the following roads in the Province of Cebu:
(a) For the Carcar-Barili road, fifty-six thousand pesos, Philippine currency.
(b) For the Sogod-Putad road, one hundred and seventy-eight thousand pesos, Philippine
